description.value: Ocean Park Pizza & Steak House is a family-run Greek-Canadian restaurant in Langley's Brookswood neighbourhood, owned and operated by Maria and Leo, immigrants from Greece with over 50 years of combined restaurant experience. In 30 years of continuous operation it has been voted best pizza in Langley and nominated best steakhouse, offering an extensive menu spanning pizza, steaks, Greek dishes, seafood, and a full bar. Touring cyclists will find a relaxed, full-service sit-down dining option with takeout also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and clearly belongs to a long-established sit-down restaurant with takeout available ('Pick Up Available After 12 Noon'). However, there is a significant address conflict: OSM records '8790 204 Street, Langley' while the website consistently states '20097 - 40th Avenue, Langley, B.C. V3A 2W3' across all pages; the website address is used as the current value per rules. The website does not mention bike parking, washrooms, or water refill, so those remain null.
concerns: Major address discrepancy: OSM records '8790 204 Street, Langley' but the business website consistently lists '20097 - 40th Avenue, Langley, B.C. V3A 2W3'. The OSM pin coordinates (49.1626, -122.6558) should be verified against the website address.
Minor name discrepancy: OSM uses 'Steakhouse' (one word) while the website uses 'Steak House' (two words).
Website references 'Closing at 9:30pm due to COVID-19', suggesting the website content has not been updated since the pandemic; current hours and operational status should be confirmed.
Phone number (604 533 4808) appears only on the website; OSM has no phone tag.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate long-running restaurant suitable for the directory, but the OSM address (8790 204 Street) directly conflicts with the address on every page of the website (20097 40th Avenue); the correct physical location must be verified before publishing.
